system.description: Usage held in 1 hand; Activate Interact (2 AP). Terrain: fortress ruins and old defensive earthworks. Kingshield moss spreads across ruined battlements and old defensive earthworks in dense, shield-shaped patches. Its upper surface is springy and green, but the layers beneath harden like overlapping scales whenever they are pressed. Ground with oil, it forms a heavy paste traditionally daubed upon champions before a siege. Applied to the skin or armour, it hardens into overlapping scales. For 10 minutes, you gain DR 2 and a +1-item bonus to DB. Temporary DR from Kingshield Moss does not stack with DR granted by another consumable. On the sheet: Temporary DR from Kingshield Moss does not stack with DR granted by another consumable. Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.
